A friendly camel offers the penguin a ride, walking slowley over the golden dunes under the burning sun. A green lizard shows the penguin a cool, shady cave, where the tired visitor sleeps for an hour.

essays.topic: Imagine a hedgehog that runs a post office in the woods. Write a short essay about a busy day there.
essays.text: The post office stands under an old oak tree. Squirrels bring parcels full of nuts. A rabbit sends a birthday card to its cousin. Then a mole asks for a stamp with a flower on it. The work is hard, but the hedgehog loves it. A bizzy squirrel carries the parcels up the hill. When the day ends, the hedgehog counts the coins. The hedgehog's litle paws are tired from the work.

essays.topic: Imagine a giant who is afraid of mice. Write a short essay about how the giant learns to be brave.
essays.title: The Frightened Giant
essays.text: The giant lives in a castle on a green hill. The giant jumps onto a chair because the mouse frightens him. The little mouse looks up with kind black eyes. Then the mouse offers the giant a crumb of cheese. The giant's huge boots stand by the door. Later the giant and the mouse become the best of friends.

essays.topic: Imagine a bear that opens a tea shop in the forest. Write a short essay about its opening day.
essays.title: My Talking Bicycle
essays.text: My old red bicycle has a funny voice. We roll down a long road through the fields. The mornning air is fresh in the quiat village. The bicycle complains about its squeaky chain. Tomorrow we will ride to the sea.

essays.topic: Imagine a bicycle that can talk. Write a short essay about a ride on it.
essays.title: My Talking Bicycle
essays.text: My old red bicycle has a funny voice. First it asks me where we are going. We roll down a long road through the fields. The bicycle sings loudly because it loves the wind. The bicycle complains about its squeaky chain. The sun is warm on our backs. When we get home, the bicycle falls asleep in the shed. Tomorrow we will ride to the sea.

essays.topic: Imagine an owl that delivers letters at night. Write a short essay about one of its journeys.
essays.title: The Night Messenger
essays.text: The old owl wakes up at dusk. A leather bag hangs from its neck. First it collects the letters from a hollow tree. Then the owl flies over the dark forest. A mouse waits at a tiny door for a letter. Little animals wave from their homes. The mouse reads the letter by candlelight. When dawn comes, the owl flies home to sleep.

essays.topic: Imagine a robot that bakes bread. Write a short essay about one day of its work.
essays.title: The Baking Robot
essays.text: The little robot wakes up early every morning. Warm water goes in with a pinch of salt. The whole kitchen smells sweet for hours. Hungry people wait at the door with empty baskets. Its metal hands are white with flour. The robot dreams of new kinds of bread at night.
